requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

requires.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Academy Manufactor, or previously used to create a copy

1486-4231-4875-5291--119--229.description:
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap two untapped creatures you control.
Magda triggers twice due to Conspiracy, creating six Treasure tokens, six Food tokens, and six three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for Cursed Mirror. If this is a clone effect, have it copy Academy Manufactor.
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap an untapped creature you control.
Magda triggers due to Conspiracy, creating at least six Treasure tokens, at least three Food tokens, and at least three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for any creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
Once you have sufficient excess Treasure tokens, you may activate Magda additional times to search your library for noncreature artifacts and put them onto the battlefield.

4336-5006-6797-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Kobolds of Kher Keep is starting in your graveyard.
4336-5006-6797-8170.description:
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Kobolds of Kher Keep spell. Then, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat.

586-678-6797.description:
Cast Priest of Gix by paying its mana cost.
When Priest of Gix enters, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Repeat.

628-3723-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Carnifex Demon.
When Carnifex Demon dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability
Repeat.

4591-6733-8089.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is a multiple of 3.
4591-6733-8089.description:
Activate Arco-Flagellant by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

765-4693-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Guildless Commons.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Guildless Commons.
When Guildless Commons dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Guildless Commons from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Guildless Commons enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Overgrown Estate ability
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3680-4661.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3680-4661.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Stunt Double and Vesuvan Doppelganger each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Stunt Double trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Vesuvan Doppelganger trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3680-4661.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

3532-5078-5705-7719.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
The Astonishing Ant-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

206-2440-3581-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Spirit you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Spirit token.
Activate the Spirit token by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature a returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
206-2440-3581-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced to as little as {1} if you control other Spirits. You can also sacrifice the Spirits once you have enough to get infinite {R}.

372-1567-7095.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Momentary Blink exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-1567-7095.description:
Cast Momentary Blink by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Chakra Meditation and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Chakra Meditation's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Chakra Meditation trigger, returning Momentary Blink from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Momentary Blink.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Chakra Meditation and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

5686-6662-7084.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Chocobo Racetrack triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

104-2034-2741-3490.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-2034-2741-3490.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

2919-3490-4050-6720.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2919-3490-4050-6720.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

380-2726-2972-6441.description:
Cast Miirym either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{G}{U}{R} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Reflections of Littjara triggers, copying the Miirym spell, creating two token copies of Miirym.
Put all but one legendary Miirym into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Miirym tokens enter, Ganax triggers twice, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the original Miirym spell. Choose to put the nontoken Miirym into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Each Miirym you control and Ganax trigger,
Resolve the Ganax trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve a Miirym trigger, creating two token copies of Miirym that aren't legendary.
When the Miirym tokens enter, Ganax triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Repeat from step 8 for each remaining trigger, if applicable.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat step 11 until you control no Treasures and/or you have enough mana to cast Miirym from the command zone.
Repeat from step 1.
380-2726-2972-6441.notes: The starting cost assume you haven't cost Miirym from the command zone this game. You can perform the combo if you've cast Miirym this game from the command zone, but will need additional mana to do so.

323-2438-5220-6900.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing it.
When Carrion Feeder dies, Mortuary and Falkenrath Noble trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Carrion Feeder from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Carrion Feeder from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1978-2750-3043.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with defender.
1978-2750-3043.description:
Cause Axebane Guardian to become an artifact using Memnarch.
Activate Axebane Guardian by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Axebane Guardian.
Repeat from step 2.

4050-5043-5078-6766.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Alela triggers, creating a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Faerie, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Repeat.

1308-2034-2043-5446.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Esika's Chariot.
When the Esika's Chariots enter the battlefield, their first abilities trigger, creating eight 2/2 Cat creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing three tokens, adding six {C}.
Repeat.
1308-2034-2043-5446.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may target any other artifact(s) with Urza's ability.

56-1417-3220-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional untapped black and/or green creature.
56-1417-3220-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Bridge from Below and Golgari Germination trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
Repeat.
56-1417-3220-5256.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

1429-5256-5402-5929.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-5256-5402-5929.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

2167-4862-5626-5721.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least {E}{E}.
You control at least six mana-producing lands, one of which can tap to produce at least {B} and another of which can tap to produce at least {G}.
2167-4862-5626-5721.description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing a land, adding one mana of any color that land could produce.
Repeat step 1 until you have at least {4}{B}{G} available and/or you control no other mana-producing lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Omnath's first ability triggers that many times, creating that many 5/5 Elemental creature tokens.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}, sacrificing a creature and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
If the sacrificed creature was an Elemental, Omnath's second ability triggers, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aftermath Analyst enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

386-790-5919.notablePrerequisites: A player has a number of cards in hand that is greater than or equal to 10 minus the lowest amount of poison counters an opponent has.
386-790-5919.description:
Cast Windfall by paying {2}{U}, causing each player to discard their hand and then draw a number of cards equal to the greatest number of cards a player discarded this way.
Razorkin Needlehead triggers for each card drawn this way, giving each opponent a poison counter for each card they drew.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters

2092-2757-2816.notablePrerequisites:
Umbral Mantle attached to a creature that does not have summoning sickness.
Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 2 or greater.
You control at least one basic land.
2092-2757-2816.description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the creature with Umbral Mantle attached, untapping the basic land.
Activate the creature by paying {1} due to Agatha of the Vile Cauldron and untapping it, giving itself +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2281-3942-4050-4871.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Karador.
Saffi dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Saffi ability.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Karador, adding {G}.
When Karador dies, Saffi and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Karador from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Cast Saffi from your graveyard by paying {G}{W}.
Repeat.
